summary: This bill reduces the experience requirement for farmers and ranchers to qualify for direct farm real estate loans from the Secretary of Agriculture, changing it from three years to one year of substantial participation in farm management or other acceptable experience, and allowing for further reduction to six months in certain cases.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends eligibility requirements for direct farm real estate loans, potentially increasing the number of eligible recipients. While it doesn't directly appropriate new funds, expanding eligibility for government-backed loans could lead to increased federal outlays over time, making it a minor driver of more government spending.
